commit_message: Document project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_title: GameEngine: define project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_body:
## Summary

- Adds ADR 0117 for the separate Launcher, project-scoped Editor, and shared project lifecycle boundary.
- Defines exclusive project leases, process-replacement switching, atomic project scaffolding, ProjectId, and user-state ownership.
- Updates the canonical authoring specification and marks the Phase 26 in-Editor Hub placement as superseded.
- Keeps ADR 0115 current-format-only behavior: compatibility is detected explicitly and old schemas are not silently migrated.

## Validation

Documentation-only change; expected Windows Validation mode: docs.
